note: Short films of Bob, fetched by the Fetch films workflow from films/sources.json. cues maps a beat to a clip: at (seconds into the line), len (how long it holds), from (start point in the clip). Empty until Paul approves; ?films=1 previews the proposed cues in index.src.html. v is the take (the start of its Higgsfield job id); change it when a clip is replaced so browsers fetch the new one.
